learning_outcomes.text: identify parts produced by open-die forging, die forging, or impression-die forging,
define and identify all the basic open-die forging operations required to produce the preform of the final part, in the most optimal order possible,
estimate the forging forces for the various basic operations as well as their respective costs,
design an optimal die for manufacturing the finished part using the die forging or impression-die forging process.

syllabus_topics: Introduction; sheet metal forming by plastic deformation (bending, deep drawing).
Bulk metal forming processes (die forging, impression-die forging); presentation of different forging machines.
Selection of the part; proposal of basic open-die forging operations.
Design and modeling of the optimal die.
teaching_methods: Tutorials carried out using a roadmap, with students working in pairs on a different, pre-selected and validated part, following an established procedure.
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*PJ1)/1, indicating that the project is the sole assessment component.
